name: alterlab-pyhealth
description: Develops, tests, and validates clinical machine learning models with the PyHealth 2.x healthcare AI toolkit. Use when working with electronic health records (EHR), clinical prediction tasks (mortality, readmission, length of stay, drug recommendation), medical coding systems (ICD, NDC, ATC, CCS), physiological signals (EEG, ECG), healthcare datasets (MIMIC-III/IV, eICU, OMOP), or implementing deep learning models for healthcare (RETAIN, SafeDrug, GAMENet, Transformer, GAT/GCN). Part of the Alter
author: AlterLab-IEU
